data.subject: Public-records note on ORN
data.body:
Hi,

De Lisle Partners LLP's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in ORN and FSBW.

On October 15, 2026, ORN disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1402829/000140282926000054/orn-20261012x8k.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research service using public records only. I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
